# Version 3.5.1 - Meet the Interactive Planner

We've transformed your calculator into a complete platform for planning perfect photography moments.

## KEY FEATURES:

**Enhanced Moon Data** - Access detailed lunar information: illumination percentage, distance from Earth, automatic detection of supermoons and micromoons, precise transit time with maximum altitude above horizon. Track the lunar cycle month by month with the new interactive calendar.

**Revolutionary Planner Tab** - Position your photo subject on an interactive map and see in real-time the directions of sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset, with precise azimuths and altitudes. Use the time slider to explore any moment of the day.

**Photographer Position Calculator** - Discover where to shoot for your desired lighting effect: backlighting for rim light, front light for raking light, side light for three-dimensional effects. The app suggests the optimal position based on sun and moon position.

**Moon Alignment** - Automatically find the exact times when the moon aligns behind your subject from your shooting position. An invisible ally for extraordinary astronomical compositions.

**Saved Plans** - Save and retrieve your favorite photography plans with custom names. Resume your work exactly where you left it.

**Shot Helper** - Real-time shadow length calculator with direction indicator. Get EV estimates and suggested camera settings (f-stop, shutter speed, ISO) for each moment of the day. Works from sunrise to twilight.

**Best Days Planner** - Scan the next 30 days and instantly rank them by shooting potential: moon phase, golden hour duration, and double-light opportunities. Find your perfect shoot day in seconds.

**Refined Interface** - Compact timeline with moon card always visible, interactive legend on the map with detailed explanations, full dark theme support.
results.description:
Have you ever missed the perfect moment to capture a photo because the light wasn't right, or because you didn't have the information to plan your photography session? With Blue Golden Hour, you'll never miss a photography opportunity again!

### YOUR COMPLETE PLATFORM FOR CREATIVE PHOTOGRAPHY

Blue Golden Hour is designed to help photographers of every level identify golden and blue hours—both morning and evening—to capture perfect light. But that's just the beginning.

### NEW: The Interactive Planner
Position your photo subject on an interactive map and visualize in real-time the precise directions of sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset with exact azimuths. Explore any moment of the day with the time slider and discover exactly where you need to shoot to achieve your desired lighting effect: backlighting for dramatic rim light, front light for raking light, side light for three-dimensional effects. The app automatically suggests the ideal photographer position.

### ADVANCED LUNAR DATA
Go beyond simple phases. Access detailed lunar information: illumination percentage, distance from Earth, automatic detection of supermoons and micromoons, exact transit time with maximum altitude above the horizon. Track the lunar cycle month by month with the dedicated interactive calendar.

### AUTOMATIC ALIGNMENT
Find the exact times when the moon aligns behind your subject from your shooting position. An invisible ally for extraordinary astronomical compositions.

### SAVED PLANS
Save your favorite photography plans with custom names. Easily retrieve your preferred shooting strategies and resume your work exactly where you left it.

### KEY FEATURES:

- Interactive planner with map for subject positioning
- Automatic photographer position calculation (three lighting effect modes)
- Enhanced moon: illumination %, distance, supermoons, micromoons
- Interactive lunar phase calendar
- Automatic moon-subject alignment
- Multiple location management and customized golden/blue hour notifications
- Intuitive and responsive interface
- Dark mode for comfort at any time of day
- No data connection required (weather data excluded)
- Saved and retrievable photography plans

### PRIVACY GUARANTEED
No location data is saved outside the app or shared with third parties for tracking or advertising purposes.

Download Blue Golden Hour today and gain access to a professional tool that transforms how you plan and execute your photography. From golden hour to lunar cycles, from the interactive planner to calculating your ideal photographer position: everything in one app.

Get ready to capture unforgettable photos!
